§3§lPurpose and mechanism§r
Keep one LM12 Portable Machine Gun in your inventory for this non-consuming check. The LM12 is an LV assembler weapon using §17.62§r mm ammo packs. Standard mode requires spin-up; suppressive mode spins up faster and avoids functional overheating, at the cost of halving the maximum fire rate. Default controls: C changes mode, V changes ammunition, and R reloads. Left-click fires and right-click aims. Key bindings can be changed in settings.

§3§lPreparation and operation§r
The assembly recipe uses steel plates, long steel rods, LV motors and a piston, LV circuits, and an integrated circuit set to §11§r. Prepare ordinary ammunition before practicing modes and reloads; inventory acceptance requires no firing. Verify key bindings and account for spin-up and mode differences during sustained fire. Suppression mode trades fire rate for its other behavior.
